023@HistoryLogProps(

025    displayName = "Basal Delivery",
026    internalName = "LID_BASAL_DELIVERY",
027    usedByTidepool = true
028)
029public class BasalDeliveryHistoryLog extends HistoryLog {
030    
031    private int commandedRateSource;
032    private int basalDeliveryFlags;
033    private int commandedRate;
034    private int profileBasalRate;
035    private int algorithmRate;
036    private int tempRate;
037    
038    public BasalDeliveryHistoryLog() {}
039    public BasalDeliveryHistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int commandedRateSource, int basalDeliveryFlags, int commandedRate, int profileBasalRate, int algorithmRate, int tempRate) {
040        super(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum);
041        this.cargo = buildCargo(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, commandedRateSource, basalDeliveryFlags, commandedRate, profileBasalRate, algorithmRate, tempRate);
042        this.commandedRateSource = commandedRateSource;
043        this.basalDeliveryFlags = basalDeliveryFlags;
044        this.commandedRate = commandedRate;
045        this.profileBasalRate = profileBasalRate;
046        this.algorithmRate = algorithmRate;
047        this.tempRate = tempRate;
048        
049    }
050
051    public BasalDeliveryHistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int commandedRateSource, int commandedRate, int profileBasalRate, int algorithmRate, int tempRate) {
052        this(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, commandedRateSource, 0, commandedRate, profileBasalRate, algorithmRate, tempRate);
053    }
054
055    public BasalDeliveryHistoryLog(int commandedRateSource, int commandedRate, int profileBasalRate, int algorithmRate, int tempRate) {
056        this(0, 0, commandedRateSource, commandedRate, profileBasalRate, algorithmRate, tempRate);
057    }
058
059    public int typeId() {
060        return 279;
061    }
062
063    /**
064     * <table border="1">
065     * <caption>Parsed fields for BasalDeliveryHistoryLog:</caption>
066     * <tr><td><code>commandedRateSource</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 10)</code></td></tr>
067     * <tr><td><code>basalDeliveryFlags</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 12)</code></td></tr>
068     * <tr><td><code>commandedRate</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 14)</code></td></tr>
069     * <tr><td><code>profileBasalRate</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 16)</code></td></tr>
070     * <tr><td><code>algorithmRate</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 18)</code></td></tr>
071     * <tr><td><code>tempRate</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 20)</code></td></tr>
072     * </table>
073     */
074    public void parse(byte[] raw) {
075        Validate.isTrue(raw.length == 26);
076        this.cargo = raw;
077        parseBase(raw);
078        this.commandedRateSource = Bytes.readShort(raw, 10);
079        this.basalDeliveryFlags = Bytes.readShort(raw, 12);
080        this.commandedRate = Bytes.readShort(raw, 14);
081        this.profileBasalRate = Bytes.readShort(raw, 16);
082        this.algorithmRate = Bytes.readShort(raw, 18);
083        this.tempRate = Bytes.readShort(raw, 20);
084        
085    }
086
087    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int commandedRateSource, int basalDeliveryFlags, int commandedRate, int profileBasalRate, int algorithmRate, int tempRate) {
088        return HistoryLog.fillCargo(Bytes.combine(
089            HistoryLog.typeIdBytes(279, 0), // 279 = 256 + 23 (byte1 must be 1, not 0)
090            Bytes.toUint32(pumpTimeSec),
091            Bytes.toUint32(sequenceNum),
092            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(commandedRateSource),
093            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(basalDeliveryFlags),
094            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(commandedRate),
095            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(profileBasalRate), 
096            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(algorithmRate), 
097            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(tempRate)));
098    }
099
100    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int commandedRateSource, int commandedRate, int profileBasalRate, int algorithmRate, int tempRate) {
101        return buildCargo(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, commandedRateSource, 0, commandedRate, profileBasalRate, algorithmRate, tempRate);
102    }
103
104    public int getCommandedRateSource() {
105        return commandedRateSource;
106    }
107
108    /**
109     * Raw value of bytes 12-13. Tandem's export does not name this field, so it is exposed as-is.
110     *
111     * <p>Only the values 0 and 3 have been observed, across roughly 49k records in two captures.
112     * 3 is written when any rate field changed versus the previous record, or when a
113     * TempRateActivated / TempRateCompleted / PumpingSuspended / PumpingResumed occurred in the
114     * 5-minute interval, and in nearly every record written while suspended. 0 is written for
115     * steady-state delivery. It is not a temp-rate indicator: it reads 0 in most records with an
116     * active temp rate. The meaning of the two individual bits is unknown; they have never been
117     * seen set independently. See https://github.com/jwoglom/pumpx2/issues/77.
118     */
119    public int getBasalDeliveryFlags() {
120        return basalDeliveryFlags;
121    }
122    public int getCommandedRate() {
123        return commandedRate;
124    }
125    public int getProfileBasalRate() {
126        return profileBasalRate;
127    }
128    public int getAlgorithmRate() {
129        return algorithmRate;
130    }
131    public int getTempRate() {
132        return tempRate;
133    }
134
135    /**
136     * Source of {@code commandedRate} (bytes 10-11).
137     *
138     * <p>Values 0, 1 and 2 are confirmed on the wire in a Control-IQ-off capture: for 2,
139     * {@code commandedRate == tempRate} in 768/768 records; for 0, the pump was suspended with
140     * {@code commandedRate} 0 and {@code tempRate}/{@code algorithmRate} both 0xFFFF in 20/20
141     * records; for 1, {@code commandedRate == profileBasalRate} in 10/10 records. 3 was observed
142     * in an earlier Control-IQ capture, where it predicted {@code algorithmRate != 0xFFFF}.
143     * 4 comes from Tandem's export value map and has not yet been observed.
144     * See https://github.com/jwoglom/pumpx2/issues/77.
145     */
146    public enum CommandedRateSource {
147        SUSPENDED(0),
148        PROFILE(1),
149        TEMP_RATE(2),
150        ALGORITHM(3),
151        TEMP_RATE_AND_ALGORITHM(4),
152        ;
153
154        private int id;
155        CommandedRateSource(int id) {
156            this.id = id;
157        }
158        public int id() {
159            return id;
160        }
161        public static CommandedRateSource fromId(int id) {
162            for (CommandedRateSource s : values()) {
163                if (s.id == id) return s;
164            }
165            return null;
166        }
167    }
168
169    /**
170     * @return the {@link CommandedRateSource} for {@code commandedRateSource}, or null if unknown
171     */
172    public CommandedRateSource getCommandedRateSourceEnum() {
173        return CommandedRateSource.fromId(commandedRateSource);
174    }

176}
